title: Point Blank
wikitext:
{{Passive skill box|Point Blank}}

{{about|the keystone passive skill|the support gem|Point Blank Support}}

'''Point Blank''' is a [[keystone passive skill]] that scales the [[damage]] of projectile [[attack]]s with respect to the [[distance]] the [[projectile]] has travelled, increasing damage initially then reducing damage after covering a long distance.

==Mechanics==
The projectile has a maximum damage increase of 30% more near the start of its travel (up to 10 units), then linearly scales down to no damage change at 35 units, then linearly scales down again to the maximum damage penalty of 30% less at 120 units.<ref name="2.1.0Patch Notes" /><ref name="DamageScaling" /><ref>https://discord.com/channels/174993814845521922/174994219390337024/986425582579490906</ref>

It is important to note that damage scaling is done with respect to the total distance the projectile has travelled, not its current distance from the point of origin.<ref name="DistanceCalc" /> If the projectile changes direction—as is the case with {{il|Spectral Throw}}—distance travelled continues to increase as the projectile returns to its point of origin.  Projectiles that travel in multiple segments (such as [[Arrow Nova Support]]) include the payload distance in the damage penalty.<ref>https://www.pathofexile.com/forum/view-thread/2688019/page/1#p22595920</ref>

==Interactions==

===Skill gem and passive skill===
{{il|Point Blank Support}} does not stack with the passive skill. A skill either has Point Blank or does not.<ref name="SkillGemStacking"/>

===Attacks only===
The Point Blank effect only works with [[attack]] projectiles.This includes projectile portions of melee weapon attacks such as {{il|Lightning Strike}}'s and {{il|Molten Strike}}'s projectiles. It does not affect spells.

===Fork, pierce and chain===
A projectile which pierces, chains or forks is still considered the same projectile, and its total travel distance is used.<ref name="SupportsandPB" />

===At Close Range===
{{il|Chin Sol}}'s more damage at close range is not Point Blank and thus stack multiplicatively.

===Projectile attacks with AoE===
Point blank bonuses are calculated based on the distance from where it was fired to the enemy hit.<ref name="RoAPB1"/><ref name="RoAPB2" /><ref name="RoAPB3" />
[[File:RoA Point Blank.jpg|thumbnail|Right|[[Rain of Arrows]] affected by Point Blank. The attack was targeting in the top right corner in this example.<ref name="RoAPB3" />]]

===Projectile speed===
Projectile speed has no impact on the distances at which Point Blank's multipliers affect damage.

===Far Shot===
{{#lst:Far Shot|data}}
[[Point Blank]] and [[Far Shot]] are multiplicative with each other and can make damage more consistent by counteracting each others' damage penalties.

[[File:PB+FS Interaction2.png|none|thumb|906x906px|The Purple Graph shows the damage scaling Interaction between Point Blank and Far Shot.]]

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.9.0|
* The Point Blank keystone now causes projectiles to deal 30% more damage to very close enemies (from 50%), dealing up to 30% less damage based on the distance the projectile travels before it hits (from 50% less).
}}
{{Version history table row|2.1.0|
* Point Blank now has less of a penalty to ranged damage, scaling down to 50% of normal damage. Previously it scaled down to no damage at maximum range. This affects both the support gem and the Keystone.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.6|
* Introduced to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
